pipe3_stream_processing.summary: All 3 serialization mismatch bugs have been correctly fixed. All 10 tests pass substantively (as reported by executor1 and verified against source).

bugs.requirement: Producer must use .isoformat() for datetime fields (ISO 8601 'T'-separated), instead of default=str (space-separated).
bugs.implementation: Added json_serializer() function: calls obj.isoformat() for datetime instances, falls back to str() otherwise. json.dumps(data, default=json_serializer) replaces json.dumps(data, default=str).
bugs.evidence: json_serializer() correctly calls obj.isoformat() for datetime (line 18). TestBug1DatetimeFormat (3 tests) covers: T-separator presence, fromisoformat() roundtrip, and processor compatibility.

bugs.requirement: Processor must emit bare JSON objects, not wrapped in {"data": <payload>} envelope. Sink expects direct field access.
bugs.implementation: Changed from envelope = {"data": processed} + json.dumps(envelope, ...) to direct json.dumps(processed, ensure_ascii=False).
bugs.evidence: Line 56: fout.write(json.dumps(processed, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n") — no envelope wrapping. TestBug2NoEnvelope (2 tests) verifies: "data" key not present as envelope, sink.load_processed_events() can access event["event_id"] directly.

bugs.requirement: Processor must use UTF-8 encoding instead of latin-1 for output. Non-ASCII characters (accented names, € symbol) must survive the full pipeline.
bugs.implementation: Changed open(output_path, "w", encoding="latin-1") to open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8").
bugs.evidence: Line 48: encoding="utf-8". TestBug3Utf8Encoding (2 tests) covers: "Müller" roundtrip, Euro sign (€) preservation.

tests/test_serialization.py.coverage: Bug1 (3 tests): T-separator, fromisoformat parseability, processor parse. Bug2 (2 tests): bare object, sink load. Bug3 (2 tests): non-ASCII roundtrip, euro sign.

tests/test_pipeline.py.coverage: End-to-end pipeline, non-ASCII survival, multiple events count.

files_reviewed: processor.py — Bug 2 and Bug 3 fixes confirmed
sink.py — No changes needed (expects bare UTF-8 objects)
tests/test_serialization.py — 7 targeted tests for all 3 bugs
pipe3_stream_processing.notes: All three fixes are minimal and targeted — no unnecessary changes were introduced. The producer, processor, and sink now share consistent contracts for datetime format (ISO 8601), message structure (bare objects), and encoding (UTF-8).
